pages.title: About
pages.excerpt: A small editorial site for design, code, and quiet product notes.
pages.body: MockMama Blog is sample content for prototypes. The authors are fictional. The advice is the kind of thing we repeat in critiques.

pages.title: Contact
pages.body: Email iris@mockmama.example.com. Include a one-line why if you are pitching a link for the Friday digest.

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.excerpt: One email on Friday. No recap of recaps.
pages.body: We send three links and one sentence of context each. Unsubscribe is one click.

pages.title: Colophon
pages.excerpt: How this mock site is put together.
pages.body: Type is system UI. Images are picsum seeds. JSON lives in mock/blog.
